1879060811.name: Wisdom of the Council
1879060811.desc: Heals Morale in a time of need.\n\nBriefly protects you, while damaging enemies who attack you.

1879064395.name: Spider's Guile (Ranged)
1879064395.desc: This fellowship skill does minor direct ranged damage to your target, then more damage over time and can contribute to fellowship manoeuvres.

1879073739.name: Latent Poison
1879073739.desc: A bite injecting a poison which weakens the target and can stun them if not cured.

1879104843.name: Curse of the Lethargic Heart
1879104843.desc: A gourd thrown at the target plagues them with spores, attacking their heart and weakening their resolve. This skill is only effective against players.

1879136971.name: Severing Strike
1879136971.desc: A high damage attack that cannot miss, be blocked or parried.

1879160011.name: Springfest Pony
1879160011.desc: A pony from the Spring Festival.

1879213899.name: Twisting the Dagger (Tactical)
1879213899.desc: Your fellowship attempts to strike Draigoch with a final blow.

1879215691.name: Grave Wound
1879215691.desc: A powerful strike that damages your foe and deals damage-over-time to the target.\n\nThis skill is more difficult for your enemies to avoid.

1879232331.name: Writ of Fire
1879232331.desc:
Stacking fire damage-over-time.

May be applied up to three times, increasing the Writ's tier.

+20% damage per tier increase.

1879242315.name: Mearas-lore
1879242315.desc: One with nature and the elements the Mearas are adepts at using the natural world against their enemies; as students of nature, beasts and hidden lore so too are Lore-masters who study these wild horses.

1879244875.name: Clash of Steel and Will
1879244875.desc: This quick strike saps your target's morale and has a chance on a critical strike to restore power to you and your war-steed.

1879255499.name: Radiant Burst
1879255499.desc: You hurl a lens toward your target distracting and potentially dismounting them. The glimmering light will attract a murder of crows to hamper the target's movement once the distraction dissipates.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill cannot be used on a target under the effects of 'Murder of Crows' the movement reducing effect applied by Radiant Burst.</rgb>

1879270475.name: For the Free Peoples
1879270475.desc: Consume all of your Advanced Technique to reduce the damage you and your allies take for a brief time.\n\nThe potency of this effect increases for each Advanced Technique consumed.

1879276107.name: Entrenchment
1879276107.desc: Your attackers' onslaught finds fewer holes in your defences, reducing the damage you take.

1879302603.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Warden)
1879302603.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879305547.name: Rain of Arrows
1879305547.desc: Rains arrows down upon your enemies, allowing you to hit multiple targets.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879335499.name: Shobdo the Little Mûmak
1879335499.desc: Summons a little mûmak to keep you company.

1879345099.name: Steed of Elessar's Host
1879345099.desc: A token of thanks for your actions before the Battle of the Black Gate.

1879352139.name: Sunflower Steed
1879352139.desc: A pony from the Summer Festival.

1879368651.name: Silver Goat Kid
1879368651.desc: Brings out a silver goat kid to keep you company.

1879374539.name: Guide to Skarháld
1879374539.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Skarháld.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879391435.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Elvish Swordswoman)
1879391435.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879400139.name: Choking Vines
1879400139.desc: Your companion projects a vine that can quickly choke a target.

1879411787.name: Slip Free
1879411787.desc: Well versed in the grappler's tricks, Brawlers can quickly slip out of holds, traps, and other attempts to constrain them.\n\nRecover from being dazed, stunned, or knocked down.

1879447371.name: Rust Corgi
1879447371.desc: Brings out a friendly corgi to keep you company.

1879452363.name: Friendly Stork
1879452363.desc: Summons a beautiful stork to accompany you on your journeys.

1879460555.name: Muster at Carn Dûm
1879460555.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Carn Dûm.

1879463371.name: Anniversary Celebration Goat
1879463371.desc: Summons an energetic young goat to accompany you on your journeys.

1879489227.name: Unbridled Fury
1879489227.desc: Your companion lets out a terrifying roar, gaining an offensive bonus for each enemy in range.

1879500363.name: Mushroom Hunter's Frog
1879500363.desc: Summons a friendly frog to accompany you in your hunt.

1879506251.name: Return to Dun Shûma
1879506251.desc: You're able to quickly return to Dun Shûma in Khûd Zagin in the Ikorbân Valley. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879506635.name: Banish the Light
1879506635.desc: Call upon the Darkness beneath the north mountains to weaken the foes of Angmar.

1879509067.name: Piercing Arrow
1879509067.desc: A Piercing Arrow wounds and dismays your foe, causing subsequent ranged attacks to restore your Morale for a brief time.
